changeability.rationale: The named bug (sprite) and every formatting rule land in exactly one place, which is the ideal. The two duplication seams — card construction inlined in three builders and the repeated variety/types resolution — mean a change to how a card is built or a Pokémon is resolved needs 2–3 coordinated edits.

abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions are designed around the app's real variation (pokemon-vs-species, per-list extras, level-up-vs-other tables) rather than being over-general. The gap is that CardList can't stretch to the team's per-item buttons, forcing markup duplication — adding an Items section still means copying the route/data shape rather than instantiating it.

findings.issue: teamPage duplicates the default-variety lookup and slot-sorted type resolution already implemented in pokemonPage (data.ts:243-252); a change to how a species' default Pokémon/types are resolved must be made twice
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared helper (e.g. defaultPokemon(species) → {pokemon, types}) next to pokemonPage and use it in both

findings.issue: Re-implements CardList's <ul class="card-grid"> markup with PokemonCard inside, because CardList offers no way to add per-item content
findings.suggestion: Give CardList a named slot or an optional itemSuffix component$ so the team page composes rather than copies

findings.issue: The card literal {id, name, label, sprite} is constructed in three places (cardsForPokemon:81, homePage:139, teamPage:397)
findings.suggestion: Add a makeCard(id, name, extra?) helper so the card shape and sprite rule have one definition

findings.issue: The core data module imports from the feature-specific lib/team.ts (coverageRows, TypeRelations), inverting the dependency direction
findings.suggestion: Move coverage computation into its own module (e.g. lib/coverage.ts) that both data.ts and team.ts import

findings.issue: Components import Card/EvolutionNode/TypeRef from lib/data.ts, which is annotated 'Server only' (data.ts:1); the import is type-only so it's harmless, but it blurs the module's boundary
findings.suggestion: Move shared view types to a lib/types.ts (or lib/format.ts) that both sides legitimately import

findings.issue: Card.hidden and the 'Hidden ability' note exist only to serve the ability pages; removing Abilities would leave this field and the .card-note CSS (global.css:256) as dead code
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is, but when removing a feature sweep optional fields and their CSS in the same change

findings.issue: No test script and zero tests in app/; every edit above (especially the extractions suggested here) has no regression net
findings.suggestion: Add at least smoke tests around lib/data.ts and lib/team.ts pure functions

summary: This is a conventionally and carefully layered Qwik City app: thin routes, one server-only data module, one API/cache module, one formatting module, and a small component kit, on the current stable Qwik (1.20.3). The two hard scenarios — a sprite/species bug fix and an API base/caching change — each land in exactly one file, which is the strongest editability signal here. The Feature work left the only real debt: card construction and default-variety resolution are duplicated, and the team page bypasses CardList because it can't host per-item actions.
